sources.title: The Free Firearm Sound Library — Winchester Model 12
sources.author: Ben Jaszczak, Brian Nelson, Kevin Heras and Matthew Nanney
sources.changes: K_22P near take, single-shot slices 0.82–1.90 s and 7.42–8.50 s. Mono 48 kHz Vorbis q5; float peak normalised to -2 dBFS before encoding; 20 ms tail fade.

sources.title: Gun Reload Sounds — pump rack
sources.author: SpringySpringo
sources.changes: BR-selected rack split at 0.19 s: back 0–0.19, forward 0.19–0.40. Cues at hand start and exported rearward+dwell boundary (0.65 s); no animation stretch. Mono 48 kHz Vorbis q5, float peak -2 dBFS, 20 ms tail fade. Author requests a project link once shipped.

sources.title: Shotgun Reload Sound Effects — individual inserts
sources.author: zer0_sol
sources.changes: First Shell.mp3 0.32–0.90 s and Subsequent Shells.mp3 0.74–1.32 s: one insert, not a whole reload. Starts with each 0.9 s handling job. Mono 48 kHz Vorbis q5, float peak -2 dBFS, 20 ms tail fade. Placeholder candidates; no direct chamber insertion in this slice.

sources.title: Equipment Clicks II — hollow hull landing candidates
sources.author: LFA
sources.changes: Slices 2.34–2.69, 3.75–4.12 and 5.39–5.66 s, hollow plastic click candidates, no metal layer. Placeholder, not a recorded shotshell hull. Mono 48 kHz Vorbis q5, float peak -2 dBFS, 20 ms tail fade.

sources.title: Gungen 7.62x39 cartridge exports
sources.author: Skelly contributors
sources.changes: Generated at sourced cartridge dimensions by gungen's cartridge exporter; generic projectile profile follows its documented seating-depth assumption; case includes the fired case and primer

sources.title: Gungen hunting-cabin pump design export
sources.author: Skelly contributors
sources.changes: Original curated 12-gauge pump geometry, metres/+x forward/+y up, separate carrier and forend GLB nodes coupled in hand mode only. Loading aperture/stroke from sourced shell dimensions; integral tube capacity from geometry with labelled visual reserve estimates. See gungen/docs/pump-action-export.md.

sources.title: Gungen 5.56x45 cartridge exports
sources.author: Skelly contributors
sources.changes: Generated at sourced cartridge dimensions by gungen's cartridge exporter; round includes the projectile and case, case includes the fired case and primer

sources.title: Gungen 12-gauge shotshell exports
sources.author: Skelly contributors
sources.changes: Original project-built geometry, sourced external mm dimensions converted to metres. Unknown closure uses a labelled generic roll-crimp visual proxy at the conservative loaded envelope; fired hull is open. Wall, lip, closure card and plastic/brass look are visual approximations, not manufacturer data; unsourced primer omitted. See gungen/docs/shotshell-export.md.

sources.title: CC0 Flat Shaded Melee Weapons
sources.author: Pichuliru
sources.changes: Converted all 20 source OBJ meshes with their MTL palette material and shared T_PCL_Palette_c.png in Blender to self-contained GLBs; applied transforms, baked flat shading, kept the 1-unit-equals-1-metre scale, and oriented each long axis from the grip toward the striking end along +x. The OBJ MTL's palette path was resolved to the shared texture at the archive root.

sources.title: Pipe
sources.author: neincenets
sources.changes: Converted pipe.obj in Blender to a self-contained GLB; the download references a missing pipe.mtl, so applied a neutral metallic steel material. Used a non-uniform source-unit scale of 0.18 m/unit along the 5.15-unit shaft and 0.05 m/unit across both transverse axes (0.278 relative scale), yielding a 0.927 m shaft, 3.3 cm tube diameter and 11.7 cm elbow extent. The grip is at the lower end and the strike anchor at the upper open end; oriented the long shaft along +x.

sources.title: Cursor pack
sources.author: Ivan Voirol
sources.changes: Kept the standard top-left pointer arrow and pointing-hand sprites from cursor.png; trimmed to their silhouettes for a white difference-blended game cursor

sources.title: 3 Melee Sounds
sources.author: remaxim
sources.changes: Selected the generic swing recording, derived from qubodup's Swish - bamboo stick weapon swishes; trimmed leading silence, faded the tail, converted to 24 kHz mono Opus in Ogg, and applied loudness normalization plus true-peak limiting (final measured LUFS and true peak are in the d13b report).

sources.title: Thwack Sounds
sources.author: Jordan Irwin (AntumDeluge)
sources.changes: Converted the selected PCM WAV; trimmed leading silence, faded the tail, converted to 24 kHz mono Opus in Ogg, and applied loudness normalization plus true-peak limiting (final measured LUFS and true peak are in the d13b report).

sources.title: 75 CC0 Breaking/Falling/Hit SFX
sources.author: rubberduck
sources.changes: Selected two wooden item-drop clips, a pouch-handling clip, and a placeholder fist hit; trimmed leading silence, faded tails, converted to 24 kHz mono Opus in Ogg, and applied loudness normalization plus true-peak limiting (final measured LUFS and true peak are in the d13b report). The fist-hit placeholder is wired to the live and restored melee-action path when the fists profile is active.
